name: Frostglass Fist
description: Punch with a fist sheathed in cold clear glass that bites with frost where it lands.

name: Frostglass Plate
description: Raise a plate of frozen glass whose icy face chills the hand of whoever strikes it.

name: Frostglass Stride
description: Slide forward on a thin slick of frozen glass laid down under each step.

name: Frostglass Cage
description: Freeze clear glass round the opponent's legs until the limbs are locked within it.

name: Frostglass Ward
description: Hold a cold ward of clear glass that chills each blow and slows it as it falls.

name: Frostglass Salve
description: Lay a film of cold clear glass over an ally's burn to take out the heat and close the skin.

name: Frostglass Crash
description: Drop a block of frozen glass on the target so the guard shatters and the arm behind it numbs.

name: Frostglass Bloom
description: Burst cold glass outward in a ring of frozen petals that cuts every foe close.

name: Absolute Frostglass
description: Freeze the whole field to cold clear glass so every foe near is cut and locked in it.

name: Frozen Prism
description: streams: Crystal + Ice; grow a prism of ice-clear crystal that splits the cold into beams and freezes whatever they touch.

name: Lightglass Fist
description: Punch with a fist of glowing crystal that lands with a flash and a cutting edge of light.

name: Lightglass Plate
description: Raise a plate of glowing crystal that bends light and blow alike round its bright face.

name: Lightglass Stride
description: Step along a thread of crystal light and cover the ground in one bright stride.

name: Lightglass Sight
description: Let crystal and light together reveal the outline of every body hidden in shadow nearby.

name: Lightglass Lance
description: Throw a lance of crystal light that hits hard and scatters the opponent's focus.

name: Lightglass Veil
description: Hold a veil of bright crystal that bends each thrust and each ray off to one side.

name: Lightglass Return
description: Catch a blast of force on the crystal and send it back as a beam of the same weight.

name: Lightglass Clearing
description: Pour clear crystal light through an ally and burn out the shadow of a curse in them.

name: Lightglass Volley
description: Split a bolt through a field of crystals into many beams that strike each foe near.

name: Lightglass Pierce
description: Focus the crystal light to one needle point and drive it through armour and body.

name: Lightglass Mantle
description: Spread a mantle of bright crystal over the nearby allies that shields and steadies each of them.

name: Prismatic Verdict
description: Pass every held ray through the prism in a burst that pierces the foe and blinds those about.

name: Dawn Prism
description: streams: Crystal + Light; shape a great prism that turns the light itself into cutting crystal beams across the field.
